title: CareerOS Canonical Profile
description: A structural schema for the canonical CareerOS professional profile from which generated career artifacts are derived.
$comment: The top-level version field is CareerOS project metadata for this schema document; it is not a JSON Schema validation keyword.

profileVersion.description: The version identifier of this canonical profile data set.

person.description: The professional individual represented by the canonical profile.

professionalSummaries.description: Reusable professional summaries or positioning statements derived from canonical profile facts.

experiences.description: Professional roles, engagements, assignments, business activities, or other periods of work.

organizations.description: Employers, clients, institutions, sponsors, or other organizations connected to the profile.

projects.description: Distinct bodies of work that demonstrate professional capability.

skills.description: Capabilities, methods, tools, technologies, domain competencies, languages, or working styles.

achievements.description: Measurable or meaningful professional results attributable to the person.

evidence.description: Supporting material that substantiates profile claims, achievements, credentials, or artifacts.

certifications.description: Credentials, licenses, certificates, or verified training results.

artifacts.description: Generated or curated career outputs derived from canonical profile data.

targetContexts.description: Audience, role, market, geography, language, or opportunity contexts used to shape generated artifacts.

extensions.description: Project-specific extensions that preserve the distinction between canonical data, target context, and generated output.

person.description: The professional individual represented by the profile.

id.description: A stable identifier for the person within the profile.

names.description: Names used by the person in professional contexts.

contact.description: Contact channels and preferences for professional use.

languages.description: Languages relevant to professional communication or artifact generation.

positioning.description: High-level professional identity, direction, and positioning themes.

links.description: Professional web links associated with the person.

extensions.description: Additional person-level profile data not represented by the base schema.

name.description: A professional name or name variant.

usage.description: The context in which this name is used.

preferredContactMethod.description: The preferred channel for professional contact.

country.description: The country associated with the location.

region.description: The region, state, province, or county associated with the location.

city.description: The city associated with the location.

workMode.description: The work-location mode associated with the profile or role.

language.description: A language relevant to the professional profile.

proficiency.description: The person's proficiency level or description for the language.

usage.description: The professional context in which the language is used.

positioning.description: Professional identity, direction, and positioning themes.

valueProposition.description: A concise statement of the professional value offered.

targetDirection.description: The intended professional direction or opportunity focus.

themes.description: Reusable positioning themes that may guide generated artifacts.

professionalSummary.description: A reusable professional summary or positioning statement.

id.description: A stable identifier for the professional summary.

label.description: A human-readable label for the summary.

targetContextRefs.description: References to target contexts for which the summary is intended.

claimRefs.description: References to claims or profile elements supporting the summary.

extensions.description: Additional summary data not represented by the base schema.

experience.description: A professional period, role, engagement, assignment, or business activity.

id.description: A stable identifier for the experience.

title.description: The role title or experience label.

organizationRefs.description: References to organizations involved in the experience.

dateRange.description: The time period associated with the experience.

location.description: The location context for the experience.

engagementType.description: The type of professional engagement represented by the experience.

scope.description: The scope, responsibilities, or operating context of the experience.

achievementRefs.description: References to achievements associated with the experience.

projectRefs.description: References to projects associated with the experience.

skillRefs.description: References to skills demonstrated by the experience.

evidenceRefs.description: References to evidence supporting the experience.

extensions.description: Additional experience data not represented by the base schema.

organization.description: An employer, client, institution, sponsor, or other organization.

id.description: A stable identifier for the organization.

description.description: A short description of the organization.

industry.description: The industry or domain associated with the organization.

location.description: The location context for the organization.

links.description: Web links associated with the organization.

extensions.description: Additional organization data not represented by the base schema.

project.description: A body of work that demonstrates professional capability.

id.description: A stable identifier for the project.

description.description: A description of the project and its professional relevance.

dateRange.description: The time period associated with the project.

experienceRefs.description: References to experiences associated with the project.

organizationRefs.description: References to organizations associated with the project.

skillRefs.description: References to skills demonstrated by the project.

achievementRefs.description: References to achievements associated with the project.

artifactRefs.description: References to artifacts produced by or related to the project.

evidenceRefs.description: References to evidence supporting the project.

extensions.description: Additional project data not represented by the base schema.

skill.description: A capability, method, tool, technology, domain competency, language, or working style.

id.description: A stable identifier for the skill.

category.description: A grouping or classification for the skill.

description.description: A description of the skill and its professional context.

evidenceRefs.description: References to evidence supporting the skill.

extensions.description: Additional skill data not represented by the base schema.

achievement.description: A measurable or meaningful result attributable to the person.

id.description: A stable identifier for the achievement.

contextRefs.description: References to experiences, projects, education, or certifications that provide context for the achievement.

skillRefs.description: References to skills demonstrated by the achievement.

evidenceRefs.description: References to evidence supporting the achievement.

extensions.description: Additional achievement data not represented by the base schema.

evidence.description: Supporting material that substantiates a profile claim.

id.description: A stable identifier for the evidence item.

title.description: A human-readable title for the evidence item.

description.description: A description of what the evidence supports.

evidenceType.description: The kind of supporting material represented by the evidence item.

links.description: Web links or file references associated with the evidence.

relatedRefs.description: References to profile elements substantiated by the evidence.

extensions.description: Additional evidence data not represented by the base schema.

education.description: A formal or structured learning record.

id.description: A stable identifier for the education record.

institutionRef.description: A reference to the institution or organization associated with the education record.

program.description: The program, degree, course, or learning path name.

fieldOfStudy.description: The field or subject area of study.

dateRange.description: The time period associated with the education record.

achievementRefs.description: References to achievements associated with the education record.

evidenceRefs.description: References to evidence supporting the education record.

extensions.description: Additional education data not represented by the base schema.

certification.description: A credential, license, certificate, or verified training result.

id.description: A stable identifier for the certification.

issuerRef.description: A reference to the issuing organization or authority.

dateRange.description: The issue and validity period associated with the certification.

credentialId.description: An identifier assigned to the credential by the issuer.

skillRefs.description: References to skills supported by the certification.

evidenceRefs.description: References to evidence supporting the certification.

extensions.description: Additional certification data not represented by the base schema.

artifact.description: A generated or curated career output derived from canonical profile data.

id.description: A stable identifier for the artifact.

artifactType.description: The kind of career output represented by the artifact.

targetContextRefs.description: References to target contexts used to shape the artifact.

sourceRefs.description: References to canonical profile elements used to derive the artifact.

derivedFromProfileVersion.description: The profile version or source state from which the artifact was derived.

status.description: Freshness state of the generated artifact relative to the canonical profile.

dateRange.description: The lifecycle period associated with the artifact.

links.description: Web links or file references associated with the artifact.

extensions.description: Additional artifact data not represented by the base schema.

targetContext.description: A context that guides selection, ordering, tone, language, detail, and emphasis for generated artifacts.

id.description: A stable identifier for the target context.

label.description: A human-readable label for the target context.

audience.description: The intended audience for the context.

role.description: The role or opportunity focus for the context.

market.description: The market, industry, or domain focus for the context.

geography.description: The geographic focus for the context.

language.description: The language focus for generated artifacts in this context.

seniority.description: The seniority level or career stage focus for the context.

emphasis.description: Themes, skills, claims, or profile elements to emphasize in this context.

extensions.description: Additional target-context data not represented by the base schema.

dateRange.description: A flexible time period associated with a profile element.

start.description: The start date, year, or time label for the period.

end.description: The end date, year, or time label for the period.

label.description: A human-readable date or duration label.

isCurrent.description: Whether the period is currently active.

link.description: A web link, file reference, or other locator associated with a profile element.

label.description: A human-readable label for the link.

linkType.description: The kind of link or locator.

description.description: A description of what the link represents.

ref.description: A reference from one profile element to another.

type.description: The kind of profile element being referenced.

label.description: A human-readable label for the reference.
